papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Calibration of a Vehicle-Mounted Microphone Array for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Microphones let an autonomous vehicle sense into areas its cameras and LiDAR cannot see, by picking up the sound that other traffic participants emit. Locating those sources and fusing them with the visual perception requires the microphone array to be calibrated and registered relative to the vehicle's other sensors. Existing calibration methods assume small, unobstructed indoor rigs, whereas a vehicle body casts an acoustic shadow that straight-line propagation cannot represent, and to our knowledge no calibration of an array distributed around a vehicle has been reported. We propose a pipeline that uses a balloon burst as a single cross-modal target, which the LiDAR locates in metric coordinates, every microphone hears as a sharp onset and a camera times. Each observation is weighted by its own timing variance, which discounts shadowed arrivals instead of discarding them and needs no model of the vehicle. On a full-size vehicle with eight microphones over a 4.9 m aperture, the held-out range residual of 6.37 cm approaches the 6.07 cm floor set by the onset timing noise, and the calibrated array tracks a moving source to within a few degrees of the vehicle's own LiDAR. A dozen bursts spread around the vehicle suffice, and spreading them matters more than adding more.

papers.summary_zh: 针对车载麦克风阵列缺少可行标定方法的问题，提出以气球爆裂为跨模态目标、按各观测计时方差加权且无需车身模型的时空标定流程，在八麦克风4.9米孔径实车上实现6.37厘米留出距离残差并跟踪移动声源。

papers.abstract_zh: 麦克风使自动驾驶车辆能够感知其摄像头和LiDAR无法看到的区域，方法是拾取其他交通参与者发出的声音。定位这些声源并将其与视觉感知融合，需要将麦克风阵列相对于车辆其他传感器进行标定和配准。现有标定方法假设使用的是小型、无遮挡的室内装置，而车身会产生直线传播无法表示的声影，且据我们所知，尚未有关于围绕车辆分布式阵列标定的报道。我们提出一套流程，使用气球爆裂作为单一跨模态目标，由LiDAR将其定位到度量坐标，每个麦克风将其听作陡峭起始，并由摄像头计时。每个观测按其自身计时方差加权，从而对受声影影响的到达进行降权而非丢弃，且无需车辆模型。在一辆全长4.9 m孔径上布置八个麦克风的全尺寸车辆上，留出距离残差为6.37 cm，接近由起始计时噪声设定的6.07 cm下限，且标定后的阵列跟踪移动声源的误差在车辆自身LiDAR的几度以内。围绕车辆分布约十几次爆裂即可，且分散布置比增加更多爆裂更重要。

papers.title: RaMOD: Moving-Object Detection from Raw mmWave Radar Cubes under Ego Motion
papers.abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides weather-robust sensing and direct Doppler measurements, yet automotive perception pipelines often reduce its output to sparse point clouds or two-dimensional projections, leaving raw range-azimuth-Doppler (RAD) cubes underutilized. Ego motion induces Doppler responses from world-static structures, while Doppler wrapping aliases radial velocities, complicating moving-object detection and velocity estimation. We present RaMOD (Radar-based Moving-Object Detection), a real-time framework for moving-object detection and velocity estimation from raw RAD cubes acquired by a vehicle-mounted single-chip radar. RaMOD explicitly estimates frame-wise ego motion and uses the estimated radar translational velocity to predict the Doppler region of world-static structures and suppress returns within it. It temporally encodes the suppressed cubes into multi-scale features to predict RAD-space boxes with class labels. For each detected object, it predicts radial and forward velocities under raw-Doppler and Doppler-unwrapped hypotheses, together with Doppler-wrapping probabilities. On our BRIDGE-Liv dataset, RaMOD outperforms all compared raw-radar methods across RAD-cube, RA, and RD detection settings, achieving 80.8% cube mAP at IoU 0.30, 15.7 percentage points above the strongest RAD-cube baseline. Velocity MAE is 1.128 m/s, with 99.87% Doppler-wrapping accuracy.

papers.abstract_zh: 毫米波（mmWave）雷达提供耐候性感知和直接多普勒测量，然而汽车感知流水线常将其输出简化为稀疏点云或二维投影，导致原始距离-方位-多普勒（RAD）立方体未被充分利用。自运动引发世界静态结构的多普勒响应，而多普勒混叠使径向速度产生混叠，从而复杂化运动目标检测和速度估计。我们提出RaMOD（基于雷达的运动目标检测），一种从车载单芯片雷达获取的原始RAD立方体进行运动目标检测和速度估计的实时框架。RaMOD显式估计逐帧自运动，并利用估计的雷达平移速度预测世界静态结构的多普勒区域并抑制该区域内的回波。它将抑制后的立方体时间编码为多尺度特征，以预测带有类别标签的RAD空间边界框。对于每个检测到的目标，它在原始多普勒和多普勒解混叠假设下预测径向和向前速度，并给出多普勒混叠概率。在我们的BRIDGE-Liv数据集上，RaMOD在RAD立方体、RA和RD检测设置中优于所有比较的原始雷达方法，在IoU 0.30时达到80.8%的立方体mAP，比最强的RAD立方体基线高15.7个百分点。速度MAE为1.128 m/s，多普勒混叠准确率为99.87%。

papers.title: CroCoMAE: Cross-modal self-supervised collaborative representation learning for SAR-optical remote sensing data
papers.abstract: Remote sensing increasingly captures the Earth's surface through complementary sensors such as SAR and optical, yet ground-truth annotations remain scarce, limiting supervised approaches. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses the label scarcity, and cross-modal SSL further exploits the complementarity between co-located sensors, but existing cross-modal frameworks align modalities mostly through global image-level representations or treat them as largely redundant, leaving their fine-grained complementary structure underexploited. We propose CroCoMAE, a cross-modal SSL framework for SAR-optical remote sensing that unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling within a ViT-based architecture, operating at two complementary levels. At the image level, an intra-modality contrastive loss on the class token yields globally discriminative, augmentation-invariant representations. At the patch level, masked image modeling drives fine-grained per-modality representations, while a cross-modal contrastive objective aligns a shared subspace across SAR and optical patch tokens, leaving the complementary subspace unconstrained to retain modality-specific information. On two SAR-optical benchmarks covering scene classification and semantic segmentation, CroCoMAE improves over uni-modal SSL baselines and outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal frameworks in most configurations, with gains in both single-modality and multi-modal evaluation across varying label regimes and the largest improvements on semantic segmentation.

papers.abstract_zh: 遥感日益通过SAR和光学等互补传感器捕获地球表面，但地面真值标注仍然稀缺，限制了监督方法。自监督学习（SSL）缓解了标签稀缺问题，跨模态SSL进一步利用同址传感器之间的互补性，但现有跨模态框架大多通过全局图像级表示对齐模态，或将其视为基本冗余，未充分利用其细粒度互补结构。我们提出CroCoMAE，一种面向SAR–光学遥感的跨模态SSL框架，在基于ViT的架构内统一对比学习和掩码图像建模，并在两个互补层级上运行。在图像级，对类别token施加模态内对比损失，得到全局判别性强且增强不变的表征。在patch级，掩码图像建模驱动细粒度的逐模态表征，同时跨模态对比目标在SAR和光学patch token之间对齐一个共享子空间，而互补子空间不受约束以保留模态特有信息。在覆盖场景分类和语义分割的两个SAR–光学基准上，CroCoMAE优于单模态SSL基线，并在大多数配置下超过最先进的跨模态框架，在不同标签机制下的单模态和多模态评估中均有增益，且在语义分割上提升最大。

papers.title: Dual-Stream Cross-Modal Representation Learning via Residual Semantic Decorrelation
papers.abstract: Cross-modal learning has become a fundamental paradigm for integrating heterogeneous information sources such as images, text, and structured attributes. However, multimodal representations often suffer from modality dominance, redundant information coupling, and spurious cross-modal correlations, leading to suboptimal generalization and limited interpretability. In particular, high-variance modalities tend to overshadow weaker but semantically important signals, while naïve fusion strategies entangle modality-shared and modality-specific factors in an uncontrolled manner. This makes it difficult to understand which modality actually drives a prediction and to maintain robustness when some modalities are noisy or missing. To address these challenges, we propose a Dual-Stream Residual Semantic Decorrelation Network (DSRSD-Net), a simple yet effective framework that disentangles modality-specific and modality-shared information through residual decomposition and explicit semantic decorrelation constraints. DSRSD-Net introduces: (1) a dual-stream representation learning module that separates intra-modal (private) and inter-modal (shared) latent factors via residual projection; (2) a residual semantic alignment head that maps shared factors from different modalities into a common space using a combination of contrastive and regression-style objectives; and (3) a decorrelation and orthogonality loss that regularizes the covariance structure of the shared space while enforcing orthogonality between shared and private streams, thereby suppressing cross-modal redundancy and preventing feature collapse. Experimental results on two large-scale educational benchmarks demonstrate that DSRSD-Net consistently improves next-step prediction and final outcome prediction over strong single-modality, early-fusion, late-fusion, and co-attention baselines.

papers.abstract_zh: 跨模态学习已成为整合图像、文本和结构化属性等异构信息源的基础范式。然而，多模态表示常受模态主导、冗余信息耦合和虚假跨模态相关性困扰，导致泛化次优且可解释性有限。高方差模态往往会掩盖较弱但语义重要的信号，而朴素融合策略会以不受控的方式纠缠模态共享与模态特有因素。这使得难以理解究竟是哪个模态实际驱动了预测，也难以在某些模态含噪或缺失时保持鲁棒性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出双流残差语义去相关网络（DSRSD-Net），这是一个简单而有效的框架，通过残差分解和显式语义去相关约束来解缠模态特有与模态共享信息。DSRSD-Net引入：（1）双流表示学习模块，通过残差投影分离模态内（私有）与模态间（共享）的潜在因素；（2）残差语义对齐头，使用对比和回归式目标的组合将来自不同模态的共享因素映射到公共空间；（3）去相关与正交损失，在强制共享流与私有流之间正交的同时正则化共享空间的协方差结构，从而抑制跨模态冗余并防止特征坍缩。在两个大规模教育基准上的实验结果表明，DSRSD-Net在下一步预测和最终结果预测上持续优于强单模态、早期融合、晚期融合和协同注意力基线。

papers.title: Calibrated Multimodal Representation Learning with Missing Modalities
papers.abstract: Multimodal representation learning harmonizes distinct modalities by aligning them into a unified latent space. Recent research generalizes traditional cross-modal alignment to produce enhanced multimodal synergy but requires all modalities to be present for a common instance, making it challenging to utilize prevalent datasets with missing modalities. We provide theoretical insights into this issue from an anchor shift perspective. Observed modalities are aligned with a local anchor that deviates from the optimal one when all modalities are present, resulting in an inevitable shift. To address this, we propose CalMRL to calibrate incomplete alignments caused by missing modalities. CalMRL leverages the priors and the inherent connections among modalities to model the imputation for the missing ones at the representation level. To resolve the optimization dilemma, we employ a bi-step learning method with the closed-form solution of the posterior distribution of shared latents. We validate its mitigation of anchor shift and convergence with theoretical guidance. By equipping the calibrated alignment with the existing advanced method, we offer new flexibility to absorb data with missing modalities, which is originally unattainable. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of CalMRL. The code is released at https://github.com/Xiaohao-Liu/CalMRL.

papers.abstract_zh: 多模态表示学习通过将不同模态对齐到统一的潜空间来协调它们。近期研究将传统的跨模态对齐推广以产生增强的多模态协同，但要求同一实例的所有模态均存在，这使得利用普遍存在的含缺失模态数据集变得困难。我们从锚点偏移的视角对该问题提供了理论洞见。观测模态与一个局部锚点对齐，而该局部锚点偏离了所有模态均存在时的最优锚点，从而导致不可避免的偏移。为解决此问题，我们提出CalMRL来校准由缺失模态引起的不完整对齐。CalMRL利用模态的先验及模态间的内在联系，在表示层面为缺失模态建模补全。为解决优化困境，我们采用两步学习方法，使用共享潜变量后验分布的闭式解。我们在理论指导下验证了其对锚点偏移的缓解和收敛性。通过将校准后的对齐与现有先进方法结合，我们提供了吸收含缺失模态数据的新灵活性，而这原本是无法实现的。大量实验证明了CalMRL的优越性。代码发布于 https://github.com/Xiaohao-Liu/CalMRL 。
